name: Vibes penta-chroma lines
desc: Bobby-Hutcherson-style vibraphone lead in F# minor pentatonic with bebop chromatic approach tones sliding into the chord tones from a half step below; phrases breathe in four-bar arcs, peak double-times into sixteenth bursts. F# minor pent sits inside B dorian for odd-meter fusion kits.

root.doc: semitone offset from F# minor pentatonic home

code.full: note("<[f#4 [f4 f#4] a4 b4] [[a#4 b4] ~ c#5 [e5 c#5]] [b4 [a4 g#4] a4 f#4] [[e4 f4] f#4 ~ [a4 b4]]>").add(note(${root})).s("vibraphone").clip(1.2).shape(.5).gain(${gain}).lpf(${cut}).pan(sine.range(.4,.6).slow(16)).room(.4).delay(.25).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.28).every(8, x=>x.rev()).orbit(5).play()
code.peak: stack(note("<[f#4 [f4 f#4] a4 [b4 c#5]] [[a#4 b4] c#5 [e5 c#5] b4] [[b4 c#5] [a4 g#4] a4 [f#4 e4]] [[e4 f4] f#4 [a4 b4] [c#5 e5]]>").add(note(${root})).s("vibraphone").clip(1).shape(.55).gain(${gain}).lpf(${cut}*1.1).pan(sine.range(.38,.62).slow(12)), note("<~ ~ ~ [~ ~ ~ [f#5 e5]]>").add(note(${root})).s("vibraphone").clip(.7).shape(.5).gain(${gain}*.6).pan(.64)).room(.38).delay(.22).delaytime(.25).delayfeedback(.25).every(4, x=>x.rev()).orbit(5).play()
